item.title: Hezbollah, Iran unleash coordinated cluster bomb strikes on Israel in major escalation
item.summary: Hezbollah prepares guerrilla warfare tactics in south Lebanon as Israel launches airstrikes against Beirut strongholds, with expert predicting Israeli ground invasion.

item.title: WATCH: NYC terror suspect allegedly seen purchasing fireworks fuse days before attack
item.summary: A Pennsylvania man accused in an ISIS terror plot allegedly bought a fireworks fuse days before throwing explosive devices at a NYC protest outside Gracie Mansion.

item.title: Beloved 75-year-old math teacher found dead inside Baltimore elementary school
item.summary: A 75-year-old Maryland math teacher who died over the weekend was discovered inside her Baltimore elementary school, with police saying there were no signs of foul play.

item.title: San Jose police investigate violent altercation caught on camera as potential antisemitic hate crime
item.summary: San Jose police are investigating a potential antisemitic hate crime following a violent attack at Santana Row. Authorities say the suspects allegedly used antisemitic hate speech.

item.title: Rubio designates Afghanistan as 'state sponsor of wrongful detention': 'Despicable tactics'
item.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio designated Afghanistan as a state sponsor of wrongful detention, accusing the Taliban of using terrorist tactics against Americans.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: ICE says El Paso detention facility will stay open under new contractor after $1.2B deal scrapped
item.summary: ICE detention facility Camp East Montana gets operational upgrade under Secretary Noem's new contract, expanding medical care despite previous closure reports.

item.title: Michigan man found guilty of killing wife whose body was discovered in fertilizer tank
item.summary: Michigan man found guilty of wife's murder after her remains were discovered in farm fertilizer tank marked "out of service" in nationally watched case.

item.title: Melissa Joan Hart gets flooded with praise from fans after flaunting her body in oceanside bikini photo
item.summary: Melissa Joan Hart stuns fans in a blue bikini Instagram post, calling it her "new profile pic." The "Sabrina" star, 49, received praise from followers.

item.title: Maggie Gyllenhaal reveals Trump election inspired her to direct films like feminist horror 'The Bride'
item.summary: Maggie Gyllenhaal said Donald Trump's 2016 election inspired her to become a film director, revealing this while promoting her feminist horror film "The Bride!"

item.title: Super Bowl hero Matt Snell dies after lengthy illness, decades-long grudge with Jets
item.summary: Former Jets running back Matt Snell, who rushed for 121 yards in Super Bowl III and set franchise records, has died. His 4,285 yards rank fourth in franchise history.
